alpha, 10 Hz. the strongest patterns and colours in flicker studies.
theta, 6 Hz. the rhythm EEG shows in deep meditation.
theta, 4 Hz. the drowsy, dreamy edge of falling asleep.
low beta, 14 Hz. alert attention. fast flicker: stop if it feels harsh.
delta, 2 Hz. deep sleep. sound only, because light keeps you up.
custom mix. your sliders, your rules.
this app flashes red light across your whole view, from 0.5 to 40 times a second, while it plays pulsing sound.

• a small number of people have seizures from flashing light, even with no history of them.
• don't use it if you have epilepsy, have ever had a seizure, or a doctor told you to avoid flashing light.
• not for anyone under 18.
• don't use it when tired, unwell, or after alcohol or drugs.
• sit down first: you won't see the room.
stop at once if you feel dizzy, twitch, lose track of where you are, or feel unwell: press B or the Meta button. rest before you drive.
